normalization_plan.reason: The pool id parameter only selects the pool processed by depositTokens and carries no independent security meaning
The amount parameter is consumed directly by the internal deposit accounting and should fold into that function
The recipient parameter only parameterizes the reward transfer performed by safeHptTransfer
The new treasury address parameter is stored directly by the owner-only setter
The local minted-liquidity amount only flows within depositTokens toward the deposit call
The resolved pair local is a validity check against poolInfo inside depositTokens
The pending reward local feeds the reward transfer inside withdraw and has no standalone role
The sushi pending local feeds the sushi reward transfer inside withdraw and has no standalone role
